pack.kept_as_is: D4A_merged_whole is never edited: C1-6cat gets its own pack and manifest

replacement_target.rule: the new tool-calling data is matched to the historical 492,587 first; its deviation from 2,960,507 / 6 is reported, never closed by cutting a turn, repeating an example or filling from another category

steps_for_a_new_tool_part.rule: T = ceil(3 x (kept training sequences + new tool sequences) / 2) at batch size 2, 3 epochs (training_plan_proposal.json); warmup max(10, round(0.05 T)), evaluation every max(25, T // 8), save every max(200, T // 2)
